investigation_notes.Decoded Script: vssadmin deleteshadow /all /quiet; bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled no; bcdedit /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures
investigation_notes.Description: A Base64-encoded PowerShell command was executed on WKSTN-SR-42 by the Administrator account and triggered the alert. The decoded commands delete all shadow copies and modify boot/recovery settings, actions commonly associated with ransomware and destructive activity. The process hash shows no AV detections but has a negative community reputation and the command ran under a high-privilege account, so this behavior warrants escalation as a High Priority incident.
